text: The normal CSF and HLA typing results make paraneoplastic or autoimmune causes less likely. Given your history of ataxia, do you have a family history of early-onset dementia, psychiatric symptoms like psychosis or depression, or involuntary movements such as tremors or chorea?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (Shy-Drager Syndrome)

The normal workup for metabolic, infectious, and autoimmune causes leaves me to consider a neurodegenerative disorder. Given your description of worsening clumsiness specifically on the right side and the "drunk" appearance of your gait, do you also experience urinary urgency, hesitancy, or episodes of orthostatic lightheadedness?
